routes: partner /dashboard; admin /employee-management; shared signed-in partner/admin shell
symptom: At exactly 768 CSS px the sidebar container is 0 px wide, the desktop sidebar collapses to 14 px, and the mobile toolbar is absent. Primary navigation is effectively unavailable.
suggestedFix: Align the CSS and TypeScript breakpoint predicates in both app shells and the shared sidebar. Retain one navigation mode at 767, 768 and 769 px; verify open/close and keyboard access after the change.
designRule: T-0767: no hidden actions; design-language §7 Craft interaction/focus availability (application of the rule, not a prescribed breakpoint).
evidence: Both diagnostic runs show toolbar at 767, no toolbar plus 14 px sidebar at 768, and 224 px sidebar at 769. Menu opens at 400.

symptom: Export and delete-account button labels truncate to “Export…” and “Smazat…”. Each label gets 54 px while the full Czech text needs 114 px and 96 px.
suggestedFix: Remove the fixed small-width constraint for these standalone actions or give the button enough content width. Keep the existing single-line ellipsis fallback.
designRule: design-language §7 Content: every CTA names its outcome; preserve the 2026-08-27 ellipsis rule.
evidence: Two affected labels at each requested width; screenshot confirms visible ellipses.

symptom: The invoice action truncates “Zobrazit fakturu” to “Zobrazi…”. Its label gets 54 px for 93 px of text.
suggestedFix: Let the invoice action size to its content or use a full-width action on narrow screens. Preserve the ellipsis fallback.
designRule: design-language §7 Content: every CTA names its outcome.
evidence: Same label width at 400 and 768; the pay table scrolls separately and is not the cause.

symptom: Document Preview, Download, Approve and Reject controls leave only 11–12 px for labels needing 42–59 px. The visible labels are effectively initials plus ellipses.
suggestedFix: Give document action rows adequate button width and stack the controls when the card cannot hold them. Keep full action labels and the shared ellipsis fallback.
designRule: design-language §7 Content: every CTA names its outcome; action contrast matters for approve/reject.
evidence: Four affected labels in the document card at 400; these labels are not clipped in the 768 capture.

symptom: Add translation and Save labels shrink to 12 px and 11 px for 83 px and 34 px of text; screenshot shows “P…” and “U…”.
suggestedFix: Replace the small fixed action width with content sizing, stacking the action group if necessary. Keep the existing truncation fallback.
designRule: design-language §7 Content: every CTA names its outcome.
evidence: Both action labels clip at 400; the 768 capture keeps them readable.

symptom: The raw-JSON toggle has 12 px for a 125 px label. The button shows an icon and “Z…”, obscuring the alternate view.
suggestedFix: Place the toggle below the evidence heading at narrow widths or allow it enough content width. Retain the translated label and ellipsis fallback.
designRule: design-language §7 Content: every CTA names its outcome.
evidence: Measured and visible at 400; no corresponding clipping at 768.

routes: all three /login routes; partner /dashboard; partner /gdpr; admin /employee-management; shared controls; candidate routes listed in coverage JSON
symptom: Shared controls fall below the 44 px touch-target guide. Examples: customer login inputs 41 px high, login submit/eye 40 px; partner/admin login inputs 35 px, submit 39 px; mobile menu 32×32, open-menu close control 25×25, admin pagination 28×28.
suggestedFix: Keep the chosen visual button sizes while providing at least a 44×44 px interactive area; reconcile shared input, button, toolbar and pagination sizing. Check real hit areas before changing checkbox or inline-link layouts.
designRule: design-language §§3.6 and 7 Craft: touch targets at least 44 px; §7 allows 40 px visual buttons, so visual height and hit area need separate treatment.
evidence: 201 baseline capture pairs contain recorded small native-control candidates after excluding off-canvas controls. The detector is capped and does not resolve enlarged ancestor hit areas; this is not 201 independently confirmed defects. Guest cancellation action sizing was handled separately in T-0753.

symptom: Package edit never reaches a DOM measurement. Both baseline and focused retries time out after 5 seconds; no screenshot or usable layout result is available.
suggestedFix: Break the package-load effect dependency cycle: avoid tracking the weightRows read while repopulating, or make the synchronization idempotent. Verify real-data package editing before repeating the viewport audit.
designRule: Not a responsive rule violation; runtime blocker prevents coverage.
evidence: Focused retry still fails with valid priceWeight=1. packageLoadEffect calls populateForm → syncWeightRows, which reads weightRows and sets a fresh array inside the same tracked effect.

symptom: Ten captures render a partial form while recording “Cannot read properties of undefined (reading invalid)”. Complete form rendering and error states are not verified.
suggestedFix: Ensure the shared textarea has a bound form control before evaluating invalid/dirty/touched, then rerun these forms with representative data and validation states.
designRule: Not classified as a responsive finding; runtime error limits coverage.
evidence: Five route bindings × two widths. The shared textarea template reads formControl.invalid without a guard at line 52; the forms use it in base and translation fields.
